stem.text: Four students were asked to match the function with the appearance of some cell structures in an animal cell.
The functions were listed by a number.

items: mRNA passes through to the ribosome
organises microtubules to produce the spindle during cell division
packaging of hydrolytic enzymes that will remain in the cell

stem.text: The appearances were listed by a letter.

items: membranes which surround an enclosed inner cavity
a double membrane interspersed with pores
membrane-bound sacs, arranged as a flattened stack

stem.text: Which student correctly matched the numbered function with the appearance of the cell structure?
